name: [Example] Basement split push
description: Drone Lockers and CCTV from garage and the square. Support clears anti-breach utility on the Lockers wall, then the hard breacher opens it. Intel player watches the vault rotate and calls the plant once the wall is down.

name: [Example] CEO vertical squeeze
description: Two players take roof and open the CEO ceiling for vertical pressure while a hard breacher works the Executive Lounge wall from the balcony. Fifth player cuts off rotations from main stairs.

name: [Example] Basement double anchor
description: Two anchors reinforce and deny the Lockers wall and CCTV hatches. One roamer delays in garage and the square, falling back through the vault once the attack commits.

name: [Example] Tellers with garage roam
description: Anchor holds Archives with an intel player tracking drones and cameras. Roamer contests the garage and lobby early, then collapses to Tellers for the last 60 seconds.

name: [Example] Church wall breach
description: Clear the garage and drone the Church wall. Support removes anti-breach utility, hard breacher opens the wall. Intel player holds the basement stairs and watches for flanks from the sewer.

name: [Example] Cash wall take
description: Hard breacher opens the Cash wall from the outside while a soft breacher makes extra lines into CCTV from Gym. The rest trade into site together once both are open.

name: [Example] Basement anchor stack
description: Two anchors deny the Church and garage walls with a support player covering the stairs with utility. Remaining players slow-roam upstairs and rotate down late.

name: [Example] CCTV/Cash with construction roam
description: Anchor holds Cash and denies the wall. Roamer works the construction side and Bedroom. Intel player keeps cameras alive and calls the push direction for rotations.

name: [Example] Garage vertical on basement
description: Take the garage early and use a soft breacher to open floors above the wine cellar. Support player clears trap utility while intel watches the stairs from the main hallway.

name: [Example] Library pinch on Bar
description: Hard breacher opens the Bar wall while a soft breacher makes lines from the library side. Intel player tracks roamers on the trophy stairs before the team commits.

name: [Example] Wine cellar deep hold
description: Two anchors hold deep cellar angles and deny vertical. A roamer delays in the garage and on the stairs, then falls back into site as the attack commits.

name: [Example] Bar with library roam
description: Anchor holds Bar and denies the wall; support player sets utility on the Gaming Room doors. Roamer plays library and the main stairs to cut off the pinch.

name: [Example] Slow default
description: Drone out site and the roamers, take map control from two directions, and keep the hard breacher alive until support clears their wall. Push together in the last minute.

name: [Example] Two anchors, two roamers
description: Two anchors deny breaches on site, two roamers delay on opposite sides of the map, and the fifth player flexes between them with cameras.
